A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the hydrothermal process can be used to obtain xylooligosacharides and water-soluable lignins from the sweet sorghums, and the pretreatment conditions should be carefully controlled to obtain the desired degraded products.

the hydrothermal conditions of 170°C for a short reaction of 0.5 h are optimal for the production of xylooligomers, and the conditions of 170–200°C for 0.5–1.0 h are optimal for obtaining water-soluble xylan and lignins.

the hydrothermal conditions can be optimized to maximize xylooligosacharides production from sweet sorghum stem biomass.
